policy: whole new Control tenure must fit currently available physical credits before header transfer; not a new wire requirement
constraints: single transmitter owns the ledger; caller uses actual o_tx_taken
i_auth is fixed through each reset epoch
only shared Request/Response Data Pool quantities are combined
actual CMD and first-half Data charging remains in the existing port; admission does not subtract future Data twice
caller must drain remaining old Data/BE before blocking on a new header and provide legal FC slots
capacity shortfall is a local diagnostic requiring packing/transaction policy; it does not acknowledge or discard the candidate
application payload availability, fair arbitration, PHY/link timing and transaction semantics require independent integration
